import pytest
from orders.service import Order, ship_order, OrderCancelledError


def test_cancelled_order_cannot_be_shipped():
    order = Order(id="C1", status="cancelled", quantity=1)
    with pytest.raises(OrderCancelledError):
        ship_order(order)
explanation: Builds the cancelled precondition the requirement names and asserts ship_order rejects it. No existing test constructs a cancelled order, which is why the guard removal survived.
rationale: pytest.raises(OrderCancelledError) on a cancelled order is the assertion that detects the missing guard.
